$schema_note: Lives at https://leonlek.github.io/doospend-docs/changelog.json. Deploy alongside the rest of the docs (cp docs/*.json ../doospend-docs/ && git push). The DooSpend iOS app fetches this on launch and shows WhatsNewSheet whenever lastSeenVersion != version. To skip showing a release (e.g. patch with no user-visible changes), just omit its entry from the versions array.
